messages:
sophia-finance: Heads-up — customer Odysseus flagged a big embed spike on their APAC invoice for 2026-03-02. They claim ~1.1M duplicate embeds. Can eng/data confirm and advise if we should issue a provisional credit?

kevin-eng: thanks. can you paste the customer org_id and a sample request id or CSV? I can run a recount.

julia-cs: org_id is odysseus-prod. they attached a CSV, sent it to your inbox @kevin-eng. customer is asking for a credit while we sort it. :eyes:

oliver-data: quick recount done on our embed_events table for odysseus-prod in APAC between 2026-03-02 02:00 and 05:00 UTC. see query I ran and a summary below.

oliver-data: ```sql
-- duplicate request_id counts  (sample)
SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM embed_events
WHERE org_id = 'odysseus-prod'
  AND region = 'apac'
  AND ts >= '2026-03-02 02:00:00'
  AND ts <  '2026-03-02 05:00:00'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

oliver-data: sample results (anonymized):
- request_id abc123 -> cnt 4
- request_id def456 -> cnt 3
- request_id ghi789 -> cnt 3
Estimated duplicate rows across window: 1,078,432 extra embed events (sum(cnt)-distinct_count).

kevin-eng: looking at apac-proxy logs — we have a burst of upstream 502/503s causing client retries + our client-side retry logic to re-send. logs show a tight window where ack ids were duplicated because the proxy returned an error after ingest succeeded. snippet:

kevin-eng: ```
[2026-03-02T02:12:03Z] apac-proxy-2 upstream_status=502 request_id=abc123 attempt=1 ack=true
[2026-03-02T02:12:04Z] apac-proxy-2 upstream_status=200 request_id=abc123 attempt=2 ack=true
```

kevin-eng: effect is we ingest the same embed twice because the first attempt succeeded server-side but the proxy returned an error and client retried. our ingest path currently writes before de-duplicating on ack_id in a later stage.

deploy-bot: region-proxy alert — apac-proxy-2 had elevated 502/503 between 2026-03-02T02:10 and 2026-03-02T03:08 UTC. queued_requests peak=123456.

julia-cs: customer is pushing for quick resolution; they shared their invoice and want a pro-rated fix if counts don’t reconcile.

sophia-finance: proposed approach: 1) grant provisional credit for estimated duplicates, 2) eng/data run dedupe + replay to produce canonical counts, 3) true-up (charge or refund) in next invoice. propose provisional $1,200 to be safe. thoughts?

kevin-eng: technical note — we can dedupe on request_id+ack_id and reprocess events. risk: if a client legitimately retried (server never saw first attempt) we might drop valid events. But given logs, the majority look like proxy-visible retries. estimate net refundable duplicates ~= 1.05M embeds -> ~$1,146. provisional $1,200 OK from our side.

billing-bot: Created provisional credit ticket FIN-2345 for $1,200 tied to: odysseus-prod, period=2026-03-02, reason="apac-proxy duplicate ingest". Status: pending-approval.

sophia-finance: I approve provisional credit and I sent a note to the customer explaining we're investigating and will reconcile. Julia to handle customer comms.

julia-cs: sent customer message: "We've issued a provisional credit while we run a full recount and replay; we'll follow up with final numbers by EOD Friday." customer replied :thumbsup:.

oliver-data: running the full dedupe+replay job now. ETA ~4h. I'll post final distinct counts and a reconciliation table when done.

sophia-finance: thanks everyone — mark this as provisional and keep thread updated. once oliver posts final numbers we'll either finalize the credit or invoice for the delta. :handshake:
